pages: Rafe, a boy of nine, short brown hair, a coarse white linen shirt with rolled sleeves and a brown leather apron, walks both hands round the long wooden quern handle. Middle distance: two grey stones in an oak frame, a scoop of wheat. Background: whitewashed wall, low window. Grey morning light.

Rafe, a boy of nine, short brown hair, a coarse white linen shirt with rolled sleeves and a brown leather apron, stands still at the quern with one hand laid flat on the long wooden handle, brow furrowed. Middle distance: two grey stones in their oak frame, wheat in his palm. Background: open bakehouse door, flagged yard. Low morning light.

Rafe, a boy of nine, short brown hair, a coarse white linen shirt with rolled sleeves and a brown leather apron, drops a thimbleful of wheat from his fingers into the round eye of the upper stone. Middle distance: one iron peg with a head, a wooden wedge, the trough below. Background: oak frame, low window. Grey light.

Rafe, a boy of nine, short brown hair, a coarse white linen shirt with rolled sleeves and a brown leather apron, holds his open palm under the quern's mouth, coarse grey meal heaped in it. Middle distance: the peg standing high, a bowl of fine flour. Background: whitewashed bakehouse, low window. Flat grey light.

Rafe, a boy of nine, short brown hair, a coarse white linen shirt with rolled sleeves and a brown leather apron, crouches by the frame and taps the head of the peg down with his heel. Middle distance: one wooden wedge on the stone floor, oatmeal-coloured meal in the trough. Background: bakehouse wall, low window. Cold light.

Rafe, a boy of nine, short brown hair, a coarse white linen shirt with rolled sleeves and a brown leather apron, carries one heavy bushel sack of wheat up onto his shoulder by its edge. Middle distance: a handcart of sacks, spilled kernels, a scoop. Background: open door, a cart in the yard. Low sun.

Mrs Ansty, a woman of sixty, grey hair under a linen cap, a red wool gown and a white flour-dusted apron, pushes her hand deep into the flour and rubs a pinch between thumb and finger. Middle distance: the quern trough heaped with meal, waiting sacks, a wooden scoop. Background: bakehouse, low window. Low afternoon light.

Rafe, a boy of nine, short brown hair, a coarse white linen shirt with rolled sleeves and a brown leather apron, squeezes one pinch of flour shut in his fist over the quern trough, watching it. Middle distance: a wooden bowl of flour, a heap of coarse meal. Background: bakehouse, low window. Low afternoon light.

Jonas Pike, a lean man of fifty, grey beard, brown wool coat, black leather apron, crouches at the quern frame with one thumb pressed on the head of the iron peg. Middle distance: the wide bored hole in the oak, two grey stones. Background: the bakehouse, a low window. Grey afternoon light.

Jonas Pike, a lean man of fifty, grey beard, brown wool coat, black leather apron, presses one round grindstone wheel down onto the top of the iron peg, both hands guiding it. Middle distance: a tin of water, an oil can, bright filings. Background: the work bench, a low window. Grey afternoon light.

Rafe, a boy of nine, short brown hair, a coarse white linen shirt with rolled sleeves and a brown leather apron, writes on one wooden tally board by the door with a stub of chalk. Middle distance: a wooden peck measure on the shelf, an open poor box. Background: bakehouse floor, low window. Low evening light.

Rafe, a boy of nine, short brown hair, a coarse white linen shirt with rolled sleeves and a brown leather apron, sets a pan of flour on one small balance scale and leans in to read the beam. Middle distance: the tally board, a box of brass weights. Background: work bench, low window. Low evening light.
